facts.textJa: 15:17では同じエタンがメラリ人の中に挙げられ、父名はKushaiahと綴られます。Kishiとの関係は本文だけでは確定しません。

wikipedia.title: Kishi (biblical figure)
wikipedia.noteJa: 記事はキシをメラリ人の系譜に置きます。クシャヤとの同一性は歴代誌上15:17の表記も含めて比較されますが、本文だけでは確定しません。
wikipedia.locator: Article lead, lines 108–111; identifies Kishi also as Kushaiah, Merarite, cites 1 Chronicles 6:44.

records.findingJa: 1CH 6:44 names Ethan son of Kishi; 1CH 15:17 lists same named Ethan among Merari and spells father Kushaiah. Current always-visible fields are gated to 6:44; later name comparison is confined to a 15:17 fact and the related-section link is also gated 15:17. Article current body explicitly says “Kishi (also Kushaiah)” and cites 1CH 6:44, but this does not establish whether the two WEB forms refer to one individual; relation-only/identityVerified=false is appropriate.
records.unresolvedJa: Kishi/Kushaiahの個体同一性は本文だけでは確定しない。Meshaの適合Wikipedia記事は実読確認できていない。

primaryCitation.text: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

currentReaderFields.subtitleJa: カレブの長子、ジフの父
currentReaderFields.summaryJa: メシャはカレブの長子として挙げられ、ジフの父とされます。カレブはエラフメエルの兄弟です。
currentReaderFields.historicalRoleJa: カレブの長子、ジフの父

records.findingJa: 1CH 2:42 explicitly calls Mesha Caleb’s firstborn and father of Ziph; the following clause says Caleb is brother of Jerahmeel. The current summary preserves that syntax and does not make Mesha Jerahmeel’s nephew. No Wikipedia article has been independently identified; primary text alone supports the displayed claims, while article status remains unverified rather than no-fit.
records.unresolvedJa: Wikipedia適合記事は独立実読していない。検索記録を記事不存在の証明として扱わない。

limitationsJa: Meshaの適合記事有無は未確定。Kishi記事の同名/表記関係は、記事の記載があることと固定WEB内部の同一性確定を区別した。
